docs.t: Transport: How to reach Nashik
docs.s: Nashik can be reached by air, rail, bus and road. Rail and road from Mumbai and Pune are the usual routes; this page shows what we know, how sure we are, and which official source to check before you go.
docs.x: transport overview how to reach nashik

docs.t: Transport: By air
docs.s: Nashik (Ozar) Airport is the city's airport. Whether scheduled commercial flights operate, and to where, is set by airlines and the airport operator and has not been verified here. A new terminal has been approved, and press reports describe a push to start civil operations before the Mela. Mumbai and Pune airports are the alternatives; confirm flights with the airlines.
